extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. Use speechManager.speakNumber() for reading numbers aloud. The game must teach: (1) Data collection and pictographs — data is information we collect. We collect data by counting, asking questions, or observing. A pictograph uses pictures/symbols to show data. Example: 🍎🍎🍎 = 3 apples, 🍎🍎🍎🍎🍎 = 5 apples. Each picture = 1 item (or a set number). Pictographs make data easy to read. (2) Classification and comparison of data — classify data into groups (e.g. fruits: apples, bananas, mangoes). Compare groups: which has most? Which has least? How many more apples than bananas? Data tables organize information in rows and columns. (3) Tally marks — tally marks are a way to count. Make 4 vertical lines (||||), the 5th line is a diagonal cross through them. This makes groups of 5, easy to count. Example: 7 = |||| (5) + || (2) = 7. 12 = ||||  ||||  || (two groups of 5 + 2). (4) Patterns with unit of repeat — a pattern has a repeating unit. Example: Red-Blue-Red-Blue-Red-Blue, the unit is 'Red-Blue'. Shape patterns: Circle-Square-Circle-Square, unit is 'Circle-Square'. Number patterns: 2,4,6,8,10, unit is 'add 2'. (5) Extending patterns using a rule — find the rule, then continue. Rules: add 2 (2,4,6,8,10...), add 5 (5,10,15,20,25...), add 10 (10,20,30,40,50...), subtract 10 (100,90,80,70...). To find the rule: look at the difference between consecutive terms. To extend: apply the rule to get the next term. Misconceptions: 'tally marks are just random lines' (tally marks are organized in groups of 5 — 4 vertical + 1 diagonal — for easy counting), 'a pattern can be anything' (a pattern has a RULE that repeats — random arrangements are not patterns), '2,4,6,8 next is 9' (the rule is add 2, so next is 10, not 9), 'pictograph and bar chart are the same' (pictograph uses pictures, bar chart uses bars — both show data but differently), 'data is only numbers' (data can be pictures, words, or observations — it is any information collected). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function DataPatternsGame), NOT export default. Export interface DataPatternsGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
